# KLYVEN

> KLYVEN — Engineering Tomorrow.

KLYVEN is a software company founded in 2026 by Naman Sharma and Ayush Mishra. It custom-builds software, AI-native platforms, and real-time systems — from local delivery apps to open-source tools — and publishes the research behind its products, in the open.

## Company

- Founded: 2026
- Founders: Naman Sharma, Ayush Mishra
- Model: free and open-source tools + premium commercial products
- Website: https://klyven.qzz.io
- Contact: Klyven4UU@gmail.com

## Products

- Nexcarto: Next-generation geospatial platform — commercial product
- Pikoo OS: Personal AI operating system — commercial product
- Klyven Tools: Free and open-source tools, libraries, and frameworks — MIT-licensed
- Open-source research projects published in the open (see https://github.com/klyven)

## Services

- Custom Software: Tailored AI-native platforms, APIs, and real-time systems
- OS & Infrastructure: Operating systems, low-level tooling, and cloud-native infrastructure
- Software Built for Schools: Custom software for schools and institutions

## Research

- Project Sparrow: AI that runs on dramatically lower hardware requirements — large memory AI research and models
